# harvester_kubeovn_vlan (Resource)

A kube-ovn VLAN tags the traffic of the kube-ovn subnets attached to it on a provider network.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "harvester_kubeovn_provider_network" "example" {
  name              = "example-provider-net"
  default_interface = "ens4"
}

# VLAN 100 on the provider network. A kube-ovn subnet joins it by setting
# its vlan attribute to the name of this VLAN.
resource "harvester_kubeovn_vlan" "example" {
  name             = "example-vlan"
  vlan_id          = 100
  network_provider = harvester_kubeovn_provider_network.example.name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) A unique name
- `network_provider` (String) Name of the kube-ovn provider network that carries the VLAN.
- `vlan_id` (Number) 802.1Q tag of the VLAN, 0 for untagged traffic. Changing it retags the subnets of the VLAN in place.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Any text you want that better describes this resource
- `labels` (Map of String)
- `tags` (Map of String)
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `message` (String)
- `state` (String)
- `status_conflict` (Boolean) Whether another VLAN uses the same vlan_id on the same provider network. kube-ovn accepts such a VLAN but refuses to set up the subnets attached to it.
- `status_subnets` (List of String) Names of the kube-ovn subnets attached to the VLAN.
